claims: The weekend of the 2026 Masters is April 11–12.
CBS provides the main telecast from 2–7 p.m. ET for the weekend of the 2026 Masters.
Paramount+ provides early streaming coverage from noon–2 p.m. ET for the weekend of the 2026 Masters.
Specialized feeds like Amen Corner are available on Masters.com, the Masters App, and Prime Video.
Paramount+ covers Saturday Round 3 of the 2026 Masters from 12–2 p.m.
CBS covers Saturday Round 3 of the 2026 Masters from 2–7 p.m.
Paramount+ covers Sunday Round 4 of the 2026 Masters from 12–2 p.m.
CBS covers Sunday Round 4 of the 2026 Masters from 2–7 p.m.
The fubo TV app carries the CBS broadcast.
Featured Holes coverage of Amen Corner and Holes 15 & 16 starts at 11:45 a.m. ET on Masters.com and the Masters App.
ESPN handled coverage for rounds 1 and 2 (Thursday/Friday).
